body.p: Brother and sister. There were a brother and a sister, of one father and one mother. The brother and the sister were together, they hunted together, they thought the same thought. So it was, so it was for a long time. Once the brother said to his sister: "How will we live? I can't stand it! I want a wife! I need a wife!" The sister listened, having listened she said to the brother: "There in the Upper World, there is a man. I'll call that man! I neither can stand it! I want the man! I want a husband!" The brother listened, having listened he laughed, then he said to the sister: "Fine! A man will come to you by boat. You listen well! When you hear [something], call the man into the tent!" The sister said: "I'll now go to the Upper World! I'll call the man! I can't stand it! I want that man!" So the sister said, then she went off. The brother listened, having listened he said to his sister: "Fine! Well, go to that man! Call that man well! Call for three days!" The sister went off. The brother stayed in the tent. The brother thought: "The sister went to that man, does she find [him] or not? Does that man come or not? I'll leave, I'll go to another land forever! The sister comes, she wants me, it's a sin! It's terrible." So the brother thought. He was thinking and thinking, then he went off. On the fourth day the sister went back to the tent. The girl went alone. The sister had been going to the Upper World for three days, she didn't find that man. Then she went back [DCh]: Not clear why to her own tent. She came there. Her brother is not in the tent. The sister POSS2SG at emphatic pronoun.thought: "Where is the brother? Where did he go? When he comes I will lie down together [with him]! I love my brother a lot!" So the sister was thinking, she was thinking and thinking, then she fell asleep.[KAY:] 'Ð±Ñ£Ð´Ð°' - means here apparently 'very much, a lot' Early in the next morning the sister heard noise at the river. The sister stood up, having stood up she ran to the river. A devil has come swimming. The sister saw the devil, then she ran back into the tent. The devil saw the sister, having seen [her] he caught up the sister, having caught [her] up he turned the sister around. The sister bit the devil. The devil got very angry, having got angry he threw the sister into the river, then he went off. The sister swam out to the shore. Having swum out she went to her own tent. Then she thought: "What kind of devil had [DCh]: Not clear why POSS2SG at emphatic pronoun.come? Dog! Where's the brother? Where did he go? I'll go to the brother!" So the sister thought, having thought she went to search for her brother. The sister said to the people: "Where is my brother? Did you(?) see [him]?"[DCh]: Instead of "bu" ' The people said: "We don't know!" All people said: "No!we.EX' probably "hu" 'you.PL' was meant.How you [need] a brother (?)?" The sister said: "How? Is he my brother?" The sister was going and going, how many years she was going nobody knows. The brother is not there. The sister didn't find her brother. The sister is crying, she was crying, crying and said: "My heart, my brother, where are you? Who took my brother? Did a spirit take [him]? Did Bigindor take [him]?" So the sister said. Then Bigindor came and said: "What did you call? I have come!" The sister was very afraid. Bigindor got very angry. He was angry and angry, then he scolded: "What did you call? I have come!" Then Bigindor and the sister are fighting. They were fighting and fighting, the sister broke free, having broken free she ran off. The spirit of the earth ran to find [her]. Where the sister ran to, there the spirit of the earth ran, too. The sister ran up, and the spirit of the earth ran up, too. The sister ran down, the spirit of the earth ran down, too. So the sister was running and running. Then she ran to the ocean. The spirit of the earth also ran to the ocean. The sister fell into the ocean and said: "Hey, spirit! Help me!" The spirit said to the sister: "I am alone!" Then the spirit killed the sister.
